scope: New offline trusted-fixture wrapper/worker variant design. Accepted supervisor/worker-v2 bytes remain immutable. No live model/general sanitizer/Docker/resource/public API acceptance.

file_limits.result_keys: finite v2 validator coverage only; omitted from public report

success_rule: Supervisor status success AND all three ordered phases AND leader_reaped true/within_total_deadline true AND both checkpoints exact-bound/validated in prefix order AND reconciliation child success/leaderreaped/within its cap AND report encoded within limit AND own directory cleanup success. Otherwise never passed; validated partial cases remain inspectable only in allowlisted projection.
limits: Same exposed public two cases/deterministic callbacks; no held-out/independent-owner factual corroboration.
No raw result/reason/candidate/model_assessment/prompt/log/exception/path/run_id or arbitrary child metadata in public report.
Observed byte hashes of rejected oversized files are marked prefix, never claimed full-file hashes.
Best effort monotonic budget, not OS hard real-time or general descendant cleanup guarantee.
Raw full checkpoint artifacts are ephemeral trusted public-fixture local files only, deleted before final report; retaining them would need a separately reviewed scope.

supersedes.history: v1 and its REVISE decision remain immutable; this proposed correction needs fresh exact review.

reconciliation_schedule.allocation_rule: At launch derive B=min(20, outer_deadline-now-10). Launch only if B>=20; otherwise skip and mark both not_reconciled/reconciliation_budget_unavailable. No scaled phases or fresh window. Recheck time immediately before launch and subtract setup time; insufficient allocation skips.
reconciliation_schedule.supervisor: Use unchanged accepted supervisor with exactly these four ordered phases, total_seconds=B, cleanup_seconds=2, exit_seconds=1, output_limit=4096. Events are timing metadata only, no result content. 16 phase +1 exit +2 cleanup =19 <=20.
reconciliation_schedule.deadline_rule: Absolute outer deadline established before setup. Worker uses min(570, remaining-30); verifier total and every phase are clipped by its work_end=launch+B-2. Parent reserve10 covers bounded output validation/report/owned-directory teardown, not a reset. Any observed overrun prohibits passed. OS stalls remain outside hard-real-time guarantee.

reconciliation_output_schema.file_requirements: Exclusive fresh file in owned directory, one trusted writer, mode0600, same nofollow/regular/owner/single-link/stable-descriptor checks as checkpoints. Atomic rename after complete close. No preexisting destination/overwrite/retry.
reconciliation_output_schema.run_id: Exactly32 lowercase hex characters from trusted parent; exact equality. Not a credential.
reconciliation_output_schema.input_manifest_raw_sha256: Exactly64 lowercase hex matching pinned review-input raw digest passed by trusted parent.
reconciliation_output_schema.cases: Exactly2 entries in frozen protocol order; each exactly public_case_keys (5 keys), no additional keys at any depth.
reconciliation_output_schema.case_id: Exact frozen ID for ordinal, maximum32 ASCII characters.
reconciliation_output_schema.state: One of case_states; successful committed reconciliation output permits validated/unavailable/rejected only. Parent synthesizes not_reconciled after whole-verifier failure.
reconciliation_output_schema.reason_code: One of case_reason_codes; mapping: validated->validated_match, unavailable->checkpoint_missing, rejected->checkpoint_invalid or checkpoint_order_invalid, not_reconciled->reconciliation_unavailable.

checkpoint_digest.rules: Full only for complete bounded regular-file bytes actually read; prefix only for cap+1 oversized read; null for absent/order-skipped/unopened unsafe files. No path/error/free text. Prefix explicitly not full-file hash.

reconciliation_output_schema.validated_projection: null unless validated; then exactly9 projection_keys, deep-equal frozen per-case expected values after actual-result finite validation. String/status/answer/inspection/import lengths are fixed by exact frozen equality, with independent UTF8 projection serialization cap4096 bytes per case. No raw result/extensions copied. Unknown fields have exact frozen null values.
reconciliation_output_schema.parser: Parent read cap+1=16385 and reject >16384 before decoding; strictUTF8, duplicate-key rejection at every depth, max nesting16, finite integer/boolean/null types only where specified, exact keys/count/order and binding/equality checks. Reject malformed/extra fields/digests/state combinations. Read failure or verifier failure invalidates entire output; never retain partial parsed verifier cases.
reconciliation_output_schema.all_or_nothing: Only successful verifier exit plus reaped leader/within cap and exact complete schema can commit both case states; otherwise parent creates2 not_reconciled/null projections.

state_mapping.first_absent: first unavailable/checkpoint_missing/null; inspect second presence only with safe metadata; second absent->unavailable/checkpoint_missing/null, second present->rejected/checkpoint_order_invalid/null without semantic parse.
state_mapping.first_rejected: first rejected/checkpoint_invalid/null; second absent->unavailable/checkpoint_missing/null, second present->rejected/checkpoint_order_invalid/null without semantic parse.
state_mapping.first_validated: second absent->unavailable/checkpoint_missing/null; second present invalid->rejected/checkpoint_invalid/null; second present exact-valid->validated/validated_match/frozen projection.
state_mapping.presence: Absent only ENOENT for fixed path; any other safe-open/metadata error is present_invalid/checkpoint_invalid if prior prefix valid, otherwise checkpoint_order_invalid. Never infer file presence from worker_status or events.

parent_output_validation.write: Outside owned ephemeral directory to trusted fresh path; exclusive create, no overwrite/retry. Remove owned directory before publishing report. If preexisting path abort before worker; write/encode/oversize/cleanup failure cannot pass.
parent_output_validation.metadata: Only frozen vocabularies, booleans, bounded counts/hashes and phases; no raw supervisor receipt copy. Max2 case entries, max10 failure codes selected from design vocabulary in stable vocabulary order without duplicates; exactly4 verifier phases and3 worker phases at most. Counts <=2^53-1; elapsed finite0..600 or fixed deadline_exceeded flag (no arbitrary text).
parent_output_validation.failure_precedence: Existing output->abort/no report; unreaped worker->no reads/not_reconciled; budget skip or whole verifier/output rejection->not_reconciled; valid verifier cases retained but any worker/report/directory failure->failed. Report writing failure produces no claimed report/fixed error. Cleanup failure invalidates passed but cannot turn a validated projection into factual approval.
